environment: Disposable local MongoDB/Express; providers disabled; fixtures only

observations.description: Active-card source excludes delivered and cancelled orders
Open-dispute source excludes technical support tickets
B2B active-SKU source excludes inactive products
Payout chart amount equals recorded completed transfers
Non-cancelled B2C booked value is correctly summed
Whole-rupee monthly B2C values agree with booked total
Bengaluru geofence is not assigned to an invented Madhya Pradesh state
A returned geofence option round-trips to matching orders
Delivered/settled B2B metric supports persisted canonical and legacy variants
B2B booked GMV excludes carts, pending-payment drafts and legacy cancellations
An unresolved 40-day pickup remains visible in the default current-exception count
Pincode and geofence intersect instead of overriding one another
Unknown assigned area fails closed for order totals
Monthly values preserve the same currency precision as the headline total
A customer who ordered yesterday is not labelled 30-day inactive by Today selection
